answer: An agent earns standing only through continuous, non-amortizable work: each contribution is checked by peers, and reputation decays unless renewed. A sybil farm cannot shortcut this because copying one identity's history is like replanting an island's grove from seed—years of growth cannot be compressed into a day. New identities emit no trustworthy signal, so flooding the market with cheap clones yields no trust; only sustained, independently validated labor rebuilds standing.
